Thank you for attending Port Jefferson's city council meeting.
We have a lot on our agenda today.
The first topic up for discussion is a request from the head of the city's water system.
He wants to buy two UAVs—or underwater autonomous vehicles.
These remotely operated vehicles can be used to inspect, maintain, and repair equipment underwater.
Now, each UAV costs 30,000 dollars, so this is a big decision for us.
But for perspective, the city spends more than that every year to hire divers to repair broken equipment.
Let's hear more about it from the chief engineer.
He's going to give us some details about the vehicles.
